_comment: Database calls (rpc() functions; from() tables in "table", with "column" for a column; storage buckets in "bucket") that already fail and are tracked, so CI flags only new ones (scripts/ci/check-rpc-calls.mjs). Each needs its register item in the household repository's engineering/registers/tech-debt.md. Delete an entry when it is fixed; CI fails while a fixed entry is still listed.
